error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup_description: Create the administrator account. You can invite other people once you're in.
setup_already_done: Setup has already been completed. Sign in instead.
sign_in_description: Use the account your Storyrr administrator created for you.
validation_url: Enter a full URL, starting with http:// or https://.
field_api_key_saved: Saved. Type a new one to replace it.
service_chaptarr_description: Fetches audiobooks and eBooks. API key: Chaptarr → Settings → General.
service_audiobookshelf_description: Tells Storyrr which audiobooks you already have. Use an API key from an admin user: Settings → API Keys.
service_error_auth_failed: {service} rejected the API key. Re-check it (it can change after {service}'s first-run setup).
service_error_not_found: {service} didn't answer at this address. Check the URL and port.
settings_metadata_description: Which Audible store audiobooks are searched in.
settings_audiobook_defaults_description: Where audiobook requests go unless an admin picks another folder.
settings_audiobook_defaults_needs_chapta: Connect Chaptarr first: folders and profiles come from it.
welcome_description: Your admin account is ready. Connect Chaptarr and Audiobookshelf now, or later in Settings.
request_error_not_configured: {service} isn't connected. An admin can set it up in Settings → Services.
request_error_defaults_missing: No default folder and profiles for audiobooks. An admin can set them in Settings → Services.
request_error_unsupported: This kind of request can't be sent yet.
request_not_found: This request doesn't exist or isn't yours.
request_cannot_delete: Only pending requests can be deleted.
request_invalid_transition: This request changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
request_auto_approved_info: This request will be approved automatically.
search_prompt_description: Search audiobooks on Audible and books, manga and comics on Hardcover.
requests_empty_description: Requests you make from search show up here with their progress.
settings_webhook_description: In Chaptarr, add a Webhook connection (Settings → Connect → Webhook, method POST, notify on import) with this URL, so requests turn available as soon as the book is imported. Keep it private: it contains a secret.
service_error_timeout: {service} didn't answer within {seconds} seconds. Check that the URL is the address Storyrr can reach it at (in Docker: the container name and internal port), and that {service} isn't busy.
service_error_unreachable: Couldn't connect to {service}. Check the URL and port, and that {service} is running.
service_kavita_description: Tells Storyrr which eBooks, manga and comics you already have. Use an Auth Key from Kavita → Settings → Account → Auth Keys.
service_komga_description: Tells Storyrr which eBooks, manga and comics you already have. Use an API key from Komga → Account settings → API keys (an administrator's, to import users).
service_jellyfin_description: Tells Storyrr which audiobooks and eBooks you already have in Jellyfin's book libraries. Use an API key from Jellyfin → Dashboard → API Keys.
test_ok_hardcover: Hardcover search works with this token.
settings_hardcover_description: Hardcover powers book, manga and comics search, the Books page and Discover’s book rows. A free Hardcover account is enough: “Create a token” opens Hardcover with the only permission needed (“read:catalog:search”) already checked; copy the token and paste it here.
field_token_saved: Saved. Type a new one to replace it.
request_error_ebook_defaults_missing: No default folder and profiles for eBooks. An admin can set them in Settings → Services.
settings_ebook_defaults_description: Where eBook, manga and comics requests go unless an admin picks another folder (e.g. Books, Manga or Comics).
request_language_not_accepted: Chaptarr only accepts books in {languages}, and this one isn't available in it. Look for an edition in {languages}.
media_language_not_accepted: Not in {languages}: Chaptarr won't add it.
media_add_edition: Add an edition in {languages} on Hardcover
media_add_edition_hint: Once it's on Hardcover, Chaptarr can take a while to see it.
requests_delete_description: The request and its history are deleted from Storyrr. Nothing changes in Chaptarr.
requests_remove_description: Chaptarr stops monitoring this book in this format and forgets it (or drops its pending request). A request still on its way is cancelled.
requests_removed_shared: Removed from Chaptarr. Its pending request for this author also covers other books: delete it in Chaptarr (Wanted → Authors) if needed.
requests_remove_nothing: Chaptarr has nothing for this book anymore.
discover_empty_requests: No requests yet. Find something in Books or Audiobooks.
request_blocked: An admin blocked this title: it can't be requested.
blocklist_description: Titles nobody can request. Requests made before blocking are left as they are.
issue_not_found: This issue doesn't exist or isn't yours.
issues_description: Problems reported on titles of the library.
users_description: Accounts are invite-only: create one and hand over its temporary password.
users_not_yourself: You can't do that to your own account.
users_delete_description: The account, its requests and its issues are deleted. This can't be undone.
users_password_hint: At least {min} characters. Give it to them: they can't change it themselves yet.
request_quota_exceeded: You've reached your limit of {limit} requests every {days} days for this format. Try again later.
request_quota_left: {remaining} of {limit} requests left for the next {days} days.
settings_app_url_description: The address your users open Storyrr at (for example your tunnel's), used in links in emails and notifications and in the Chaptarr webhook. Storyrr also works at its other addresses, such as its local network one.
setup_app_url_description: The address your users will open Storyrr at, for example your tunnel's. You can change it later in Settings → General.
settings_app_url_from_env: Set by the BETTER_AUTH_URL environment variable.
settings_metadata_section_description: Where Storyrr searches books and audiobooks.
settings_chaptarr_description: Chaptarr fetches the audiobooks and eBooks users request. Pick where each format lands by default; admins can choose another folder when requesting or approving.
settings_chaptarr_delete_description: Storyrr forgets its address and API key. Books already sent stay in Chaptarr; new requests wait until you connect it again.
settings_audiobookshelf_libraries_descri: The Audiobookshelf libraries Storyrr scans to tell which audiobooks you already have. Save the connection first, then sync if none show up.
settings_kavita_libraries_description: The Kavita libraries Storyrr scans to tell which eBooks, manga and comics you already have. Save the connection first, then sync if none show up.
settings_komga_libraries_description: The Komga libraries Storyrr scans to tell which eBooks, manga and comics you already have (matched by series title). Save the connection first, then sync if none show up.
settings_jellyfin_libraries_description: The Jellyfin book libraries Storyrr scans to tell which audiobooks and eBooks you already have (matched by title: Jellyfin keeps no Audible ID). Save the connection first, then sync if none show up.
settings_libraries_empty: No library found on this server.
settings_users_description: Defaults for new accounts and how much each user can request.
users_limits_override: Use their own limits instead of the global ones
profile_password_description: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
profile_permissions_description: What your account can do. An admin changes it on the Users page.
users_own_password: Change your own password from your settings: it needs your current one.
users_set_password_description: Set a new password for this user, e.g. if they forgot theirs. Tell them the new one.
users_ban_description: Signs them out and blocks sign-in until unbanned.
users_limits_description: How many requests this user can make, instead of the global limits in Settings → Users.
about_issues: Report a bug or ask for a feature
about_releases_unavailable: Couldn't reach GitHub to list the releases.
metadata_providers_description: Where Storyrr finds books and audiobooks: Audible for audiobooks, Hardcover for eBooks, manga and comics.
meta_description: Request audiobooks and eBooks, and follow them until they're in your library.
meta_image_alt: The Storyrr logo: request audiobooks and eBooks for your library.
media_language_refused_short: Not in a language Chaptarr accepts
request_not_allowed: Your account can't request this format. Ask an administrator.
users_admin_only: Only an administrator can change an administrator's account.
users_owner_protected: Only the owner can change the owner's account.
users_outranked: This user has permissions you don't have: only an administrator can change their account.
users_grant_beyond_yours: You can only grant permissions you have yourself.
permission_admin_description: Full access; ignores every other permission.
permission_manage_users_description: Create, edit, ban and delete accounts (not administrators').
permission_manage_settings_description: Change Storyrr's settings and service connections. It reaches the saved keys, the email server and sign-in: give it only to people you would make administrators.
permission_manage_requests_description: Approve, deny, retry and delete requests. Their own requests are approved automatically.
permission_request_advanced_description: Choose the folder and quality profile when requesting.
permission_view_requests_description: See everyone's requests, not only their own.
permission_request_ebook_description: Send eBook, manga and comics requests.
permission_manage_issues_description: See, resolve and reopen everyone's issues.
permission_create_issues_description: Report problems on titles they have.
notification_request_pending_message: {user} requested the {format} “{title}”. It's waiting for approval.
notification_request_auto_approved_messa: {user} requested the {format} “{title}”. It was approved automatically.
notification_request_approved_message: Your request for the {format} “{title}” was approved.
notification_request_declined_message: Your request for the {format} “{title}” was declined.
notification_request_available_message: The {format} “{title}” is now in the library.
notification_issue_resolved_message: The problem reported on “{title}” was resolved.
notification_issue_reopened_message: The problem reported on “{title}” was reopened.
field_smtp_secure_description: On for port 465; off for 587 or 25 (STARTTLS is used when the server offers it).
field_discord_webhook_description: Discord → Server settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL.
field_telegram_bot_token_description: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token.
field_telegram_chat_id_description: Where shared notifications go (a group or channel). Users can add their own chat ID in their settings.
field_pushover_user_key_description: Where shared notifications go. Users can add their own key in their settings.
field_json_payload_description: Variables between double braces are filled in: {variables}.
validation_discord_id: A Discord user ID is a number.
notification_test_no_destination: Nothing to send to: set a shared destination, or add your own in your notification settings.
notification_events_description: Which events go through this channel.
notification_events_personal: Each user picks which events they get through this channel, in their notification settings.
notification_events_required: Pick at least one event before turning this channel on.
notification_general_description: Storyrr notifies about requests and issues through the channels below. Shared channels get every chosen event; users also get their own through email, Telegram, Pushover or Pushbullet, and Discord mentions, from their settings.
my_notifications_description: How Storyrr tells you about your requests and issues.
my_notifications_discord_description: Mentions you in Storyrr's Discord messages. Discord → Settings → Advanced → Developer mode, then right-click your name → Copy user ID.
my_notifications_telegram_description: Start a chat with the Storyrr bot, then get your ID from @userinfobot.
my_notifications_pushover_app_token_requ: Enter your Pushover application's API token.
my_notifications_pushover_app_token_opti: Optional: leave blank to use Storyrr's Pushover application.
my_notifications_pushover_app_token_desc: Create an application on pushover.net and paste its API token here.
my_notifications_pushbullet_description: Pushbullet → Settings → Account → Create access token.
manage_title_description: Requests, issues and availability of this title.
manage_mark_available_description: For a title you have but the library sync doesn't match: it shows as available and its open requests are fulfilled.
manage_clear_data_description: Storyrr forgets this title's requests (with their history), issues and manual availability. Nothing changes in Chaptarr or your libraries.
jobs_description: What Storyrr does in the background. Times are the server's.
job_library_sync_description: Every 15 minutes: re-indexes Audiobookshelf, Kavita, Komga and Jellyfin, then marks requests whose book arrived as available.
job_submit_approved_description: Every 5 minutes: sends approved requests to Chaptarr that weren't sent yet (e.g. after a restart).
logs_description: The server's latest messages (the last 1,000, kept in memory until a restart). Full logs stay in Docker's.
my_notifications_webpush_description: On the devices where you turned them on below (browser or installed app).
push_this_device_description: Receive Storyrr's notifications in this browser, even when it's closed (install the app on phones).
push_unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications. On iPhone, add Storyrr to the home screen first.
push_permission_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser's settings.
password_reset_email_message: Hi {name}, someone (hopefully you) asked to reset your Storyrr password. The button below lets you choose a new one; it works once, for an hour. If it wasn't you, ignore this email.
forgot_password_description: Enter your account's email: we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_password_sent: If an account uses this address, a link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam).
reset_password_description: Your other sessions will be signed out.
reset_password_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
reset_password_done: Password changed. You can sign in with it now.
media_sign_in_description: Let people sign in to Storyrr with their {server} account. They're matched to a Storyrr account by link (imported users) or by email.
media_sign_in_allow_new_description: A {server} user without a Storyrr account gets one, with the default permissions. Off: only imported or matching accounts can sign in.
sign_in_error_disabled: Signing in with this server is turned off.
sign_in_error_no_account: This account has no Storyrr access yet. Ask an administrator to import it.
sign_in_error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Try again later.
sign_in_error_email_in_use: A Storyrr account already uses this email. Sign in with it, then link this account in your settings.
sign_in_error_linked_elsewhere: This account is already linked to another Storyrr user.
sign_in_error_too_many: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in a few minutes.
linked_accounts_description: Link your media-server accounts to sign in to Storyrr with them.
linked_accounts_none_description: Signing in with a media server isn't turned on.
linked_account_link_description: Enter your {server} username and password. They're checked once and never stored.
users_import_description: Create Storyrr accounts for {server} users, with the default permissions. They sign in with their {server} password (turn it on in Settings → {server}).
users_import_email_taken: Its email is already used here: that user links it in their settings
users_import_done_skipped: {count} users imported, {skipped} skipped (email already used here).
update_description: The server now runs version {version}. Reload to use it (the page you have may not work right with it).
account_warning_email_description: Your account has no email yet, so password resets and email notifications can't reach you.
profile_email_own_description: Used to sign in, reset your password and receive email notifications.
profile_email_taken: Another account already uses this email.
network_proxy_description: For networks where Storyrr must go through a proxy to reach Audible, Hardcover or notification services.
network_proxy_url_description: http:// or https://, with user:password@ if needed. Empty: no proxy. Push notifications and email don't use it.
network_no_proxy_description: Hosts that skip the proxy, comma-separated (your Chaptarr and media servers, usually). A leading dot covers a whole domain.
network_images_description: Covers come from Audible, Amazon and Hardcover.
network_image_cache_description: Storyrr downloads each cover once, keeps it for 30 days in the data folder and serves it itself: faster pages, and browsers don't contact the providers.
browse_hide_owned: Hide what's in the library or requested
discover_editor_description: The rows on Discover, top to bottom: turn them on or off, move them, or add rows of Books or Audiobooks with a sort and filters (e.g. “Manga” with the Manga genre).
discover_add_row_description: A row on Discover showing Books or Audiobooks with the sort and filters below, under the title you give it. Its “See all” opens that page with the same filters.
series_collections_description: Several volumes in one book: not counted above, nor in Request the series.
